nexus-pos.title: Nexus POS
nexus-pos.description: A complete desktop point-of-sale system for retail stores, supermarkets, and restaurants, covering daily operations from checkout and inventory to reporting and local licensing.
nexus-pos.purpose: Provide an offline-first bilingual POS workspace for managing retail and restaurant operations, hardware, staff access, and multiple branches.
features: Retail and restaurant POS, sales, payments, credit, returns & refunds
Products, variants, inventory, purchases, suppliers, customers & expenses
Dashboard, reports, barcode scanning, receipt and kitchen printing & cash drawer
Users, roles, permissions, multi-branch architecture, Arabic / English, RTL / LTR & device licensing

almondas.title: Almondas
almondas.description: An Arabic-first social deduction party game for 3–12 players sharing one phone. Players question each other to discover who is outside the secret topic.
almondas.purpose: Turn Arabic group gatherings into a simple pass-the-phone game with randomized roles, category-based secret words, voting, and a clear result flow.
